rule: a block that repeats items names its whole-item motion part first

exempt.sgs/choice-flow-question: options belong to a question; the question is the unit
exempt.sgs/form-field-tiles: tiles are form inputs, not revealed items
exempt.sgs/nav-drawer-menu: nav items follow the navigation motion model (Spec 36)
exempt.sgs/option-picker: options are selectable pills inside a form control, not revealed items
exempt.sgs/product-card: pack sizes and colour swatches are controls inside one card, not revealed items
exempt.sgs/nav-bar-menu: nav items follow the navigation motion model (Spec 36); found once the corpus also read includes/ (independent review)
